text:
jin: FYI the Petra-Lite model entry landed with mixed field names: CSV uses `quant_profile` but model card examples and SDK expect `quantization_profile`. SDK integ tests are failing.

sara: which PR?

jin: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/1012 (Petra-Lite add). Test error: 
```
AssertionError: missing 'quantization_profile' in example snippet
Found 'quant_profile' instead
```

natalie: I can fix docs: (1) update CSV to `quantization_profile`, (2) patch model card examples, (3) add a migration blurb. I'll also add a short snippet showing both keys for a transitional release.

alex: SDK change is trivialsdk-python already accepts `quant_profile` as a fallback and logs a deprecation warning. I'll post a tiny tests PR to assert both keys pass.

dan: also note Petra-Lite's quantized variants reduce KV cache. The PR's 8k seq claim is optimistic for small GPUs; recommend 4096 for quantized runs. Add a Limits note and link to Optimize guide.

natalie: proposed Limits note: 
> Note: Petra-Lite quantized variants reduce available KV cache. For small GPUs, limit sequences to 4096 when running quantized. For long contexts, use a non-quantized or extended-KV variant.

jin: include a CI bench snippet as well.

natalie: add: 
```
# quick local bench
python bench.py --model petra-lite-quant --seq 4096 --batch 1
```

docs-bot: reminder - bump model card frontmatter version and add an entry to models/CHANGELOG.md or lint will fail.

alex: SDK PR: https://git.internal/redwood/sdk/pull/224 (tests updated). CI green.

sara: I'll add a short changelog line: "Deprecated `quant_profile`; migrate to `quantization_profile`. Accepted for one release."

jin: great, once docs PR and SDK PR merge we'll announce in release highlights. Thanks everyone."
